scope: Proposition 18.4 of the manuscript “Critical mixing in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model” (preprints/Critical-mixing-in-the-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-model-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3ac6296cc238bae9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 166. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose the parent auxiliary potential is intrinsic, satisfies the curvature invariant with slack, and its true gradient discrepancy is bounded by D/p on its agreement annulus, where D < ∞ is fixed. Put c = γp. Extend the parent potential as in Proposition 16.1 and take its log heat convolution to c. For the parameter choices above, with probability tending to one over the unused refinement, sup h∈Ac(σ) ∥Pc∇ϕc(h) − ∇e ϕc(h)∥ ≤ 1 c (1 2D + on(1) ) . (18.17) This conclusion is uniform in the child field. For a fixed finite number of comparison steps, the additive errors tend to zero simultaneously.
